referenceDefinition: Pointwise mean of the other 19 processed observation years at the same 112 retained target positions, excluding the evaluated year; diagnostic reference, not a forecast baseline.
aggregation: Per-configuration temporal Pearson r at each grid point, averaged over the same grid points for LSTM, ASTGRN, STDN and the reference. Every input must be finite at all 112 positions with positive temporal variance. An annual range uses the equal-weight mean of its configurations.

source.productsHashDefinition: SHA256 of sorted model/pre/year/kind and raw-file SHA256 ledger; no machine paths
